findings.failure_path: A controller variant can hold LOCK_EX while reading, unlock while computing/writing the temporary receipt, and reacquire LOCK_EX before replacing it. Both observations remain True and the single call returns 41, yet concurrent callers can each read 40 and both replace it with 41. The endpoint assertion therefore does not establish the newly stated whole-read-increment-replace protection.
findings.smallest_fix: Assert that the receipt lock is not released, downgraded, or closed between the read and replace observations, and verify that an unlock/relock mutation fails.
